findings.evidence: 'Would this edit surprise the document's author if they read the diff with no other context?' The 'Before you touch anything, ask yourself' section is mostly activation content the model already applies, and the Editing rules and Escalation conditions repeat it.
findings.fix: Shorten the section to the one question that is not stated elsewhere: whether the edit is a strategy judgment or a mechanical edit. Point to Escalation conditions for the rest, and record the shortened lines in docs/audit/recovery/ai-kit-spec-review-fixer/record.md.

findings.evidence: No previous-version digest was supplied, so the removal check was not run.
findings.fix: Re-run the judge with the digest from scripts/audit/audit.py judge-prompt so the removal check runs.

findings.evidence: 'Before editing' covers read, read-back and checklist, but the workflow has no step to verify edits after making them. The 'Codebase root for any Read-back verification' input is listed but never used in a step.
findings.fix: Add step 5 after editing: Read each edited document back from disk, check each addressed finding's Required: text against the new text, and confirm nothing outside the Location: changed (git diff when available) before writing the Fix Summary.

findings.evidence: Anti-patterns are given as a Common Mistakes table with reasons, but there is no Gotchas section. Environment facts that defy assumptions sit inside step text, for example 'with worktrees that root is often not your CWD'.
findings.fix: Add a short ## Gotchas section. Include the worktree-root fact; that a 'Mechanical re-pass:' finding is never CRITICAL or HIGH; and that inline document text vanishes when the subagent ends.

findings.evidence: The description gives WHAT and WHEN but no boundary against near-misses: writing the review itself (ai-kit-spec-review-checklist) and GSD plan-checker revisions. Its trigger-queries.json lists both as negatives. It also lacks user-intent phrasing for when the review is not named.
findings.fix: Applies the findings of a spec or plan review report to the reviewed design or plan document. It edits the document in place for every CRITICAL and HIGH finding, escalates strategy-level findings, keeps framework conventions (EARS, Given/When/Then, task checkboxes) when a profile is given, and ends with a per-finding Fix Summary. Use when a report from ai-kit-spec-review-checklist, or similar structured review feedback with Severity/Location/Required fields, exists and the document must be fixed. This includes the fixer step that /ai-kit-spec-review dispatches, re-passes after another review, and cross-document findings, even when the user only says 'address the reviewer's findings'. Not for writing the review itself (ai-kit-spec-review-checklist), GSD plan-checker revisions, code or PR fixes, or general proofreading.

findings.evidence: 'write it verbatim to a temp file and Read that file back' gives no location for the temp file, though a fragile step like this needs an exact one.
findings.fix: Name the location, for example '<codebase root>/tmp/spec-review-fixer/report.md' (or $TMPDIR when there is no tmp/), and say to delete it after the Fix Summary.

findings.evidence: There are 20 queries (10/10), but all are short and generic, for example 'fix the CRITICAL and HIGH items in this spec review'. None has file paths, personal context or casual typos, and most positives repeat skill vocabulary ('Fix Summary', 'Required lines'), so they barely test the description.
findings.fix: Rewrite about half the positives as realistic, context-rich prompts that do not name the skill's terms. Example: 'my reviewer left a bunch of notes in docs/review-2026-11.md on docs/plans/auth-plan.md, can u go through and patch the plan'. Add the same realism to the near-miss negatives.

findings.evidence: Evals 'edge-inline-document' and 'edge-medium-only-skipped' have "files": [] and describe their inputs only in prose ('The review report holds one MEDIUM finding...'), so a run cannot reproduce them.
findings.fix: Add fixtures under evals/files/: a one-MEDIUM-finding report for edge-medium-only-skipped, and an inline-document prompt text for edge-inline-document. Reference them in each eval's files list.

findings.evidence: 'If any input is missing, stop and ask. Do not guess paths.' The skill is dispatched as a clean-context subagent that cannot ask questions interactively, and no Status value covers a missing input: Failure is defined only for 'a document not on disk'.
findings.fix: Replace it with: 'If any input is missing, emit a Fix Summary with ### Status: Failure — missing input: <name>. Make no edits and do not guess paths.' Then widen the Status rule so Failure covers any run that could not start.

findings.evidence: The file names fixtures 'design-to-fix-baseline.md, design-to-fix-skill.md, design-to-fix-pressure.md' under ../../ai-kit-spec-review-checklist/evals/fixtures/, but that directory holds only design-bad.md, design-good.md, plan-bad.md and sample-review-report.md.
findings.fix: Say that the design-to-fix-*.md copies are created per run from design-good.md, or point the scenarios at evals/files/design-good.md, which this skill ships.
